ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.
   C. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.
   B. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.
   B. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.
   D. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Attributes of Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Attributes of Allah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Attributes of Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
   D. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels Atid,.
   C. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Belief in Angels Atid, to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Call to prophet hood 03 7.2 Earliest coverts to Islam 04 7.3 Prophets journey Ta and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Call to Prophethood and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prophets journey Taif 03 TOTAL 90 Page 12 of 63 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prophet ’s Journey to Taif and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
